questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

All Toms are Jerrys.

Some Jerrys are Mickeys.

Conclusions:

I. Some Toms are Mickeys.

II. Some Toms are not Mickeys.

III. Some Jerrys are Toms.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as follows :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/473bb7a294bf16fbfb804139a6377066b48ad4da31019f3cef120cb9f34d6570.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Toms are Mickeys → False (No definite relations given hence, false)

II. Some Toms are not Mickeys → False (No definite relations given hence, false)

III. Some Jerrys are Toms → True (All Toms are Jerrys, so some Jerrys are Toms is True)

Thus, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__**Conditions of Either-or case:

1. Individually both the conclusions should be false.

2. One conclusion should be positive and one conclusion should be negative (Complementary pair)

The two complementary pairs are:

1) All + Some not

2) No + Some

 
• Some + Some not is not a complementary pair.

questions.question:
Which two digits can be interchanged so as to balance the given equation?

76 + 108 ÷ 9 – 11 × 2 = 18
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is :-

By using **BODMAS RULE** :

 [IMAGE: https://chat.google.com/u/0/api/get_attachment_url?url_type=FIFE_URL&content_type=image%2Fpng&attachment_token=AAUuIGv5mnRkhACFi8nSNNHZe43wWNS3Dp0EzfNi%2F%2BMj7GTRCBS5sD4JJKlbLD8FISYAdKsPNoCCsYvJyBrz%2F03G1givS1%2F7%2Bac48EDIkcm3zPNuf0hPYesPxoD%2FPOEqCxpMywvNkuEjALN5eMDCfmg68KXDhWT4hlsoVOO0eMq25%2B0qNRLXD2YprQ58vi7I4WGRsJTle0iFDMrLDxdMIZjyST7m4NuU9oUjxzDIWBJe%2F%2Fe8vF%2F1IfrrW%2Bzk9zzhLOeHdgsT62r%2Fm54k2oKhHcgCEhDqWY%2F6Y3PI%2F%2FIYvpOgX7QnqKMYVJQUXh8i%2FqBPmyQbIywYmESF2pElVrK6GTPM9h8NyVREi4v0ZrucnkGOsJzzTHT3CJgmLNrEVEZ%2FoPH7IJfwXnVNNbhrZ2bQRWE1sY8TP8I9nmDX%2B2oN%2BQyM57SnzhMvWJgndOOfJ%2Bjpuoy2lpiK&sz=w512] 

Option 1) : 2 and 7

Given equation : 76 + 108 ÷ 9 – 11 × 2 = 18 

By interchanging 2 and 7 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is :

⇒ 26 + 108 ÷ 9 - 11 × 7 = 18

⇒ 26 + 12 - 11 × 7 = 18

⇒ 26 + 12 - 77 = 18

⇒ 38 - 77 = 18

⇒ 38 - 77 = 18

⇒ - 39 ≠ 18

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : 1 and 7

Given equation : 76 + 108 ÷ 9 – 11 × 2 = 18 

By interchanging 1 and 7 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is :

⇒ 16 + 108 ÷ 9 – 11 × 2 = 18

⇒ 16 + 12 – 11 × 2 = 18

⇒ 16 + 12 – 22 = 18

⇒ 28 – 22 = 18

⇒ 6 ≠ 18

LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 3) : 6 and 2**

**Given equation : 76 + 108 ÷ 9 – 11 × 2 = 18 **

**By interchanging 6 and 2 in given equation.**

**Interchanged equation is :**

**⇒ 72 + __108 ÷ 9__ – 11 × 6 = 18 **

**⇒ 72 + 12 – __11 × 6__ = 18 **

**⇒ __72 + 12__ – 66 = 18 **

**⇒ 84 – 66 = 18 **

**⇒ 18 = 18**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : 8 and 7

Given equation : 76 + 108 ÷ 9 – 11 × 2 = 18 

By interchanging 6 and 2 in given equation.

Interchanged equation is :

⇒ 86 + 107 ÷ 9 – 11 × 2 = 18 

⇒ 86 + 11.88 – 11 × 2 = 18 

⇒ 86 + 11.88 – 22 = 18 

⇒ 97.88 – 22 = 18 

⇒ 75.88 ≠ 18 

LHS ≠ RH

Thus, the correct answer is **"6 and 2".**
